# Crypto test data

Fixed inputs for known-answer tests. Never regenerate a file to make a test pass.

| File | Source | Licence | SHA-256 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `bip39_english.txt` | https://github.com/bitcoin/bips/blob/master/bip-0039/english.txt | MIT (BIP-0039 header, `License: MIT`; the list file carries no separate notice) | `2f5eed53a4727b4bf8880d8f3f199efc90e58503646d9ff8eff3a2ed3b24dbda` |
| `bip39_vectors.json` | 256-bit entropy/mnemonic pairs of https://github.com/trezor/python-mnemonic/blob/master/vectors.json, extracted with `tools/extract_bip39_vectors.py`. The raw file had SHA-256 `fa3b937b7cff9c9b8ecd3aa011faeb8d6dd67993174b72326e83f4de8fdb30f8`. | MIT | `f8c90de602baf634e86c4a4aa682e3890a881a9c0c82b8c32d859b8de303460b` |
| `common_passwords_seclists_10k.txt` | https://github.com/danielmiessler/SecLists/blob/master/Passwords/Common-Credentials/10k-most-common.txt | MIT | `68782d6a4a19a4768d5f15dd66bd534e7a33055cc755411e33f16d18c50fdcce` |
| `hkdf_vectors.json` | RFC 5869 appendix A.1-A.3 plus the five persisted info strings over a fixed IKM, generated by `tools/generate_hkdf_vectors.py` (standard library only, independent of app code; RFC cases are asserted against the published OKM) | n/a | `72b63f4e8879c7cfd5692beb87ea16735f28928cbcc7eb8cc137c193e326cd06` |
| `argon2id_rfc9106.json` | RFC 9106 section 5.3 (Argon2id, secret, associated data, 4 lanes), written by `tools/generate_argon2id_vectors.py` only after it reproduces the published pre-hashing digest and tag | n/a | `d3dbb0e1e2837b0ab7c585eebd6d1b8791b7f51a780dcd29c9ab0dba4a689614` |
| `argon2id_app_vectors.json` | Argon2id at the production parameters (64 MiB, t=3, p=1) over a fixed salt and a non-ASCII password, generated by `tools/generate_argon2id_vectors.py` (standard library only, independent of app code and of Bouncy Castle) | n/a | `9981d23867ded0f377fd7b4cdee210688b0f2156cc62431d4430cdfe7b299118` |

`shared/crypto/src/androidMain/resources/bip39_english.txt` is a byte-identical copy of `bip39_english.txt`.
`common_passwords.txt` in the same folder (SHA-256 `ca28ddb6223efe6f333388f1392ae3f50ba19b32f43152b8879e8d54236251f9`)
is built from the SecLists file plus the app words (ASCII only, 8+ characters) with `tools/build_common_passwords.py`.
